title: Room-type map
description: The room types derived from the real rooms, plus the `house` scope. Each type is validated by the runtime `room-type` schema rather than by a shape restated here: the runtime schema is the published contract, and a second copy in the catalog would be free to drift from it. The `house` scope is separate because a behaviour scoped to the house must not be forced through a room type it has nothing to do with.

room_types.description: The union of real rooms is not truncated by the corroboration rule: a type that exists in only one repo is recorded with `default: false`, because the map has to be able to express every real room even where only one house has one.

house.description: Slots that belong to the house. A house-scoped behaviour can require only slots named here, and a room-scoped one only slots some room type provides.

slots.description: Resolved against `catalog/slots.yaml`; the membership rule is the validator's, because a JSON Schema reference cannot reach into a YAML document's contents.
